instruction: Find and grade all students who scored 70 points by comparing their answer sheets with the reference answers and updating the spreadsheet.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires grading students with 70 points. Verified: Linda Garcia(row2), Richard Smith(row3), Jennifer Rodriguez(row4) all scored 70. Evaluator now verifies grading correctness by comparing with reference answers and checks for false positives.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Partial credit based on number of 70-score students graded correctly. Penalties for false positives (grading wrong students).
fixes_applied: Added extract_reference_answers() to parse ReferenceAnswers.docx and extract Q1-Q10 correct answers
